_doc: Task 34: which injuries and illnesses really get worse with time, and which never need an ambulance. Every rule says WHY (the cause), so a mechanic can be checked with 'why would this happen?'. A cause is matched by words in the reason text (lowercased) from the first row to the last; the first hit wins. 'ambulance': 'always' (rushed even at severity 1), 'by_severity' (from ambulance.hold_from_severity), 'never' (home care, or a lift or taxi to the clinic). 'worsens': true = waiting longer than worsen_after minutes can raise the severity by one (chance worsen_chance); false = waiting changes nothing. A minor injury ('strain': true) only takes longer to heal if the person keeps walking or working on it.

default.why: serious, but waiting alone does not make it worse

causes.why: bleeding gets worse every minute without first aid
burns and smoke damage keep getting worse until they are treated
a heart attack damages the heart more every minute
a stroke damages the brain more every minute
water in the lungs gets worse by the minute
an overdose keeps working on the body
poison keeps working until it is treated
the body keeps cooling until they are warmed up
the body keeps overheating until it is cooled
an electric shock can upset the heartbeat
a hard fall may hide internal injuries that get worse if the person is moved or left
a birth with complications cannot wait
a sprain does not get worse by waiting; only walking or working on it slows the healing
bruises and scrapes do not get worse by waiting
an ordinary illness is cared for at home or at the clinic and does not get worse minute by minute

text.late: The ambulance took {min} minutes. {name} got worse: {why}.
text.clinic: {name} was taken to the clinic by a neighbour.
text.clinic_taxi: {name} took a taxi to the clinic.

strain.note: while walking or working on a sprained or bruised body part, the injury timer loses 0.5 less per minute: recovery is longer
